stories.title: Flávio Bolsonaro calls himself the ‘leader of Brazil’ after fleeing to Miami
bullet_points: Far-right senator and family land in US after crossing from Brazil into Argentina and then flying via Ecuador   Flávio Bolsonaro  declared himself the “true president” of  Brazil  after losing last Sunday’s presidential election and fleeing to the United States.

After landing on a private jet with his family in Miami,  Florida , on Wednesday morning, the far-right senator published the claim in a letter – even though his own party has recognised the legitimate victory of  Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva , as have all of Brazil’s institutions, and international observers who monitored and endorsed the vote.
